pages.text: Cars get dirty as they're driven, more off-road, most in mud, twice as fast in the rain. A filthy car sells for less and its body slowly $(4)rusts$().$(br2)Right-click a car with a $(item)Water Bucket$() to wash some of it off, or use a car wash.
The Car Wash: drive up, press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch) to pay, then drive through slowly.
The Wash Bay rents you a pressure washer: hold right-click to spray a car clean.
